mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the access-control fact lets the model invent a Permitted operation whose (role, kind) pair is not in the policy matrix — e.g., a hospital_administrator reading a clinical record — which is exactly what LeastPrivilege, FR_005, and FR_017 are meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some o: Operation | o.opOutcome = Permitted and o.opCaller.role = HospitalAdministrator and o.opKind = ReadRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the no-NoteEdit fact lets the model invent a clinical-note mutation event, which the append-only invariant exists to forbid.
Clearing the no-AuditMutation fact lets the model invent an audit-entry mutation, violating immutability (FR-014) and the 7-year retention floor (FR-016).
Clearing audit completeness lets a Read/AddNote operation occur with no audit entry, violating the always-on-audit invariant and the SLA-enforced rollback rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OpWithoutAudit { some o: Operation | o.opKind = ReadRecord and no o.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing attribution lets an audit entry record an accessor different from the actual operation caller, violating audit-entry correctness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some o: Operation | some o.opAudit and o.opAudit.aeAccessor != o.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the byte-equivalent-404 invariant lets a denied operation return a clinical-content response, distinguishing denial from not-found and leaking patient existence.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakyDenialResponse { some o: Operation | o.opOutcome = Denied and o.opResponse = ClinicalReadShape }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing admin content-blindness lets a ListAudit response carry a clinical-read shape, exactly the FR-018 forbidden case.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminLeakingClinicalContent { some o: Operation | o.opKind = ListAudit and o.opResponse = ClinicalReadShape }
